FIX THE WRONG ANSWER — SUBTRACTION
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what fix the wrong answer — subtraction means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Subtraction.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
This page teaches fix the wrong answer — subtraction so you can define it, apply it near a shamba in Nyeri, and correct a common wrong idea. In plain words: subtract up to two 6-digit numbers without regrouping in real-life situations,.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Fix the Wrong Answer — Subtraction belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know, choose an operation, compute carefully, then check with a reverse step.
• Example numbers for this page: 5 and 6 combine in different ways — sum 11, product 30.
• Place value reminder: in 484, the digit 4 can mean ones, tens, or another place depending on where it sits — read the place carefully.
• Units matter: write cm, m, Ksh, or items so the answer matches the question.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a shamba in Nyeri: a learner solves a subtraction problem.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × amount each
2. Substitute values: Total = 13 × 40
3. Total = 520
Final Answer: Ksh 520 (or 520 items)
Mark reminder: method mark for correct operation; accuracy mark for answer

Wrong path to avoid: adding 13 + 40 = 53 when the question needs groups of equal size. Multiplication matches equal groups.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
At a shamba in Nyeri, practise fix the wrong answer — subtraction during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word fits, and how do I check I am right? Safety and respect come first.

SUMMARY
----
• Fix the Wrong Answer — Subtraction belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know, choose an operation, compute carefully, then check with a reverse step.
• Example numbers for this page: 5 and 6 combine in different ways — sum 11, product 30.
• Place value reminder: in 484, the digit 4 can mean ones, tens, or another place depending on where it sits — read the place carefully.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define fix the wrong answer — subtraction in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a shamba in Nyeri that shows Subtraction, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about fix the wrong answer — subtraction. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
1. Fix the Wrong Answer — Subtraction belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics. Example: connect it to something real at home, school, market, or a shamba in Nyeri.
2. At a shamba in Nyeri, observe carefully, name the correct idea from Subtraction, and explain with one subject fact from the main notes.
3. Wrong idea: mixing fix the wrong answer — subtraction with a neighbouring concept or skipping the method. Correct idea: Understand and practise: subtract up to two 6-digit numbers without regrouping in real-life situations,. Justification: follow the worked example steps on this page.
